A service protocol or URL (OGC:WMS, WFS, ESRI REST, OPeNDAP...) -> WebAPI; any other download link -> DataDownload with the distribution formats and transfer size; a linkage that is the OGC 'inapplicable' nil URL -> an archive member (hasPart) of the distribution before it (GeoNetwork DDE). information/search/browse links are left to url and relatedLink.
The first information / browse link, when the citation has no online resource.
Every online resource not used as the url or a distribution; the function code (or protocol) is the linkRelationship.

An ISO 19110 feature catalogue embedded in the record (GeoNetwork DDE writes the variables here).
The statement is one prov:Activity; each process step another, with its date as endTime, its processor as agent, and its sources as schema:object (which makes it a cdifProv Action).
CreativeWork: citation title, description, online resource.
